test_model_zoo_get_invalid: test model_zoo.get raises RuntimeError when given an invalid config path like Invalid/config.yaml
test_get_checkpoint_url: test model_zoo.get_checkpoint_url returns the correct download URL for a model's checkpoint pickle file
test_get_config: test model_zoo.get_config to load a model config such as mask_rcnn_fpn.py from common/models
test_instantiate_model: test instantiate from detectron2.config to build a model from a lazy config object
